GHA.note: It covers a portal redesign contract; no finance, tax or payroll system is described.

facts.fact: La Marina BJ reports that the launch of the CitizenApp Data Interoperability System in October 2024 marked a turning point in the integration of services and data exchange between administrations in Ghana.

GHA.note: It refers to a national digital transformation strategy without naming it or stating its adoption or text.
It says work on enterprise architecture and interoperability began in 2010; no framework is stated as drafted or adopted.
No law or decree on data sharing between public bodies is stated.
